segments.text: Everyone treats me like the black sheep just because I left law school.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker feels unfairly judged and excluded by their family or peers for leaving law school.
segments.turkishExplanation: Sırf hukuk fakültesini bıraktım diye herkes bana ailenin kara koyunuymuşum gibi davranıyor.

segments.text: That's not how we see it.
segments.englishExplanation: The other person denies that they view the speaker in such a negative light.
They explain that they were simply startled and caught off guard by the sudden choice.

segments.text: Following my passion isn't a betrayal.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker defends pursuing their true interest as a legitimate choice, not a disloyal act.
segments.turkishExplanation: Tutkularımın peşinden gitmek bir ihanet değil.

segments.englishExplanation: The speaker emphasizes that their decision was deliberate and well-considered, not careless.

segments.text: Then show us the plan and we'll hear you out.
segments.englishExplanation: The other person asks to see the strategy and offers to listen attentively to the explanation.
segments.turkishExplanation: O zaman planını bize göster, biz de seni sonuna kadar dinleyelim.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: An idiom used to describe an odd, nonconformist, or disreputable member of an otherwise respectable family or group.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir ailenin veya topluluğun diğer üyelerine uymayan, farklı ya da utanç kaynağı görülen kişisini tanımlamak için kullanılan bir deyimdir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: He felt like the black sheep when he chose art over the family business.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Aile şirketi yerine sanatı seçtiğinde ailenin kara koyunu gibi hissetti.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Usually used in the passive ('be taken aback') to describe being suddenly shocked, startled, or caught off guard by unexpected news or behavior.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Genellikle edilgen yapıda ('be taken aback') kullanılır; beklenmedik bir durum karşısında afallamak, şaşkına dönmek anlamına gelir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I was taken aback by how candid she was in the meeting.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Toplantıda bu kadar açık sözlü olmasına çok şaşırdım.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: A phrasal verb meaning to listen to someone patiently until they have finished presenting their thoughts or explanation.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir kimsenin sözünü kesmeden, anlatacaklarını bitirene kadar onu dikkatle dinlemek anlamına gelen bir deyimsel fiildir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Even if you disagree with his approach, at least hear him out.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Yaklaşımına katılmasan bile en azından onu sonuna kadar dinle.

quiz.question: In segment 3, what does the speaker mean by saying "We were simply taken aback"?

options.text: They were deeply disappointed in the decision.
They were caught off guard and very surprised.
They felt disrespected and extremely angry.
They were persuaded to change their minds.
